enrollment_date_order.name: enrollment_date_order
enrollment_date_order.value: "student_enrollment"."starts_on" is null or "student_enrollment"."ends_on" is null or "student_enrollment"."starts_on" <= "student_enrollment"."ends_on"

candidate_admitted.name: candidate_admitted
candidate_admitted.value: ("admission_candidate"."state" = 'admitted') = ("admission_candidate"."student_id" is not null and "admission_candidate"."admitted_at" is not null and "admission_candidate"."admission_number" is not null)

fee_item_values.name: fee_item_values
fee_item_values.value: "admission_fee_item"."position" between 0 and 19 and length(trim("admission_fee_item"."label")) between 1 and 80 and "admission_fee_item"."amount_minor" between 0 and 100000000

fee_item_billing_dates.name: fee_item_billing_dates
fee_item_billing_dates.value: ("admission_fee_item"."type" = 'monthly' and "admission_fee_item"."amount_minor" > 0 and "admission_fee_item"."billing_start_date" is not null and ("admission_fee_item"."billing_end_date" is null or "admission_fee_item"."billing_end_date" >= "admission_fee_item"."billing_start_date")) or ("admission_fee_item"."type" <> 'monthly' and "admission_fee_item"."billing_start_date" is null and "admission_fee_item"."billing_end_date" is null)

monthly_schedule_values.name: monthly_schedule_values
monthly_schedule_values.value: "monthly_fee_schedule"."amount_minor" between 1 and 100000000 and "monthly_fee_schedule"."next_due_date" > "monthly_fee_schedule"."start_date" and ("monthly_fee_schedule"."end_date" is null or "monthly_fee_schedule"."end_date" >= "monthly_fee_schedule"."start_date")

attendance_submitted_original.name: attendance_submitted_original
attendance_submitted_original.value: not "attendance_register"."submitted" or ("attendance_register"."original_marks" is not null and "attendance_register"."submitted_at" is not null)

attendance_mark_values.name: attendance_mark_values
attendance_mark_values.value: "attendance_register_mark"."mark" in ('Present','Absent','Late','Unmarked') and ("attendance_register_mark"."original" is null or "attendance_register_mark"."original" in ('Present','Absent','Late'))

enrollment_change_date_order.name: enrollment_change_date_order
enrollment_change_date_order.value: "enrollment_date_change"."starts_on" is null or "enrollment_date_change"."ends_on" is null or "enrollment_date_change"."starts_on" <= "enrollment_date_change"."ends_on"
